Home.title: A suspicious message. A clearer next step.
Home.intro: Pressure, an unfamiliar link, an urgent payment. Find warning signs in a message and verify the request independently.
Home.note: No account required. Review your text before sending. AI is optional and requires consent.
Home.urgent: Already sent money or shared information?
Home.demoEmpty: Run the example to see an actual analysis.
Home.demoError: Could not load the example. Open the analysis workspace.
Home.feature1Text: Results connect warning signs to specific text so you can see the basis for the analysis.
Home.feature2Text: Verify a request through a contact you already know. Never automatically trust contact details inside the message.
Home.feature3Text: Inspect and edit text after automatic masking. Redaction does not guarantee anonymity.
Home.limitsTitle: Decision support. No promise of certainty.
Home.limitsText: Rules and models can be wrong. We do not verify senders, open links or promise that a message is safe.
Home.openText: Inspect the implementation, rules and tests. Run it yourself; documentation explains the status of each feature and deployment limitations.
Home.useTitle: One message. Different reasons to pause.
Home.useIntro: Start with what the message asks you to do. A bank name or a familiar name is not verification.
Home.use1: A new number in the family
Home.use1Text: A payment request from an unfamiliar number? Check by calling a previously known number.
Home.use2Text: Check requests for account details, codes or fees independently of links in the message.
Home.use3Text: Pressure, promised returns or software installation may call for further verification.
Home.faq1Text: No. It finds potential signals and explains them with excerpts. It does not verify the sender, their intent or the actual safety of a message.
Home.faq2: What is sent to the model?
Home.faq2Text: Only when you select AI and consent: the text after your review. It may contain everything remaining in it, including URL hosts. Automatic redaction is not a privacy guarantee.
Home.faq3: Can I use it without AI?
Home.faq3Text: Yes. Rules and offline URL-shape checks work without a model request. The application does not visit suspicious links.
Home.faq4Text: The source is licensed under Apache-2.0. Current documentation distinguishes the verified rules container from unfinished production SaaS capabilities.
Home.pricingTitle: Try a message. Understand the limits.
Home.pricingText: The public demo requires no payment. AI availability depends on configuration. Commercial plans have not launched.

Analysis.reviewConsent: I reviewed the text and removed information I do not want to send.

If AI is unavailable on this server, you will receive a rules-only result.

Guidance.none: I have not acted on the message
Guidance.password: I entered a password or card details
Guidance.link1: Close the page and do not enter anything else.
Guidance.link2: If you entered information or installed software, select the corresponding option above.
Guidance.password1: From a trusted device, change the affected password and any other accounts using the same password.
Guidance.password2: If you entered banking details, contact your bank using the number on your card or in its app.
Guidance.otp1: Contact your bank immediately using a known number from your card or banking app and explain what happened.
Guidance.otp2: Do not approve further requests or share more codes.
Guidance.transfer1: Contact your bank immediately using a known number from your card or app. Ask it to investigate and whether the payment can be stopped.
Guidance.transfer2: Keep the communication and consider reporting it to the police.
Guidance.remote1: Disconnect the device from the internet and ask a trusted specialist to check it.
Guidance.remote2: Contact your bank from another trusted device and explain the possible unauthorized access.
Guidance.family: Call your relative using a number you knew before receiving this message.
Guidance.parcel: Open the carrier’s app or a website address you already know and check the parcel status there.
Guidance.independent: Contact the person or institution through a previously known contact, app or independently located address.
Guidance.title: Independent verification, step by step
Guidance.notice: This guide does not verify anything for you. Avoid contacts and links supplied in the suspicious message.
Guidance.situation: Have you already acted on the message?
Guidance.pause: Pause. Do not send money, passwords or codes, or install software based on the message.
Guidance.outcome: What happened when you checked independently?
Guidance.confirmed: I was able to verify the request
Guidance.unresolved: I could not verify the request
Guidance.confirmedNote: Use what you learned through a trusted channel. This application cannot see or confirm your verification result.
Guidance.unresolvedNote: Wait before acting. Ask a trusted person for help or contact the institution through a known channel.
Guidance.pendingNote: You can record the outcome here; it stays in this browser session.
Guidance.emergencyTitle: Already shared information or sent money?
Guidance.emergencyIntro: Act promptly. These steps can help you start addressing the situation.
Guidance.bankText: Use the number on your card or in your banking app. Explain what happened and ask for help.
Guidance.deviceText: If you installed remote-access software, disconnect the device from the internet and ask a trusted specialist to check it.
Guidance.messagesText: Keep the communication and consider reporting it to the police. In an urgent situation in Czechia, call 158.

Public.devIntro: The experimental API returns signals, excerpts and suggested steps. Results support verification; they do not establish authenticity.
Public.availability: Commercial API access, production keys and public deployment are not yet available.
Public.modesText: Try rules on the local server without a key. A test key connects requests to a signed-in local account and its test credits.
Public.guestText: No signup or credit metering. Do not use this as a public production API.
Public.keyText: Create a key in your account, store it securely and use a fresh UUID for each request.
Public.limitsText: Input size and process concurrency are bounded. Authenticated local requests also share PostgreSQL limits per key, project and workspace. Anonymous per-IP quotas and provider spending controls are not complete. Production AI is blocked; do not expose the local experiment publicly.
Public.realText: This anonymous test sends synthetic text to the server and uses rules only.
Public.responseText: Schema version, decision, signals, evidence graph, guidance and actual analysis mode. Results are not stored for later retrieval. AI requires explicit consent and returns a rules-only fallback if the model is unavailable.
Public.sendError: The request could not be sent.
Public.keyPrivacy: The key stays in this form. A successful request uses 1 test credit.
Public.synthetic: Use a synthetic example without personal information. This test sends text to the server in rules-only mode.
Public.empty: The response will appear after sending.
Public.pricingIntro: Try message analysis without an account. Commercial plans and payments are not yet available.
Public.freeText: The current experimental tool for individual messages.
Public.ai: Optional AI, subject to server availability
Public.plans: Production accounts, API keys, credit plans and subscriptions are not available. We are not collecting commercial payments or advertising unconfirmed prices.

PromptLab.title: Versions you can trace.
PromptLab.intro: Save immutable instructions, test them against the real model, and activate with an audit trail. A single test checks technical operation, not model quality or safety.
PromptLab.immutable: Saved versions cannot be overwritten. Create a new version for changes. Do not put secrets or private messages in instructions.
PromptLab.name: Version name
PromptLab.testNote: Activation requires a successful test of the same version and configured model within the last 7 days. Tests incur provider charges; they do not consume user test credits.
PromptLab.consent: I reviewed the test text and consent to sending it to the configured model provider.
PromptLab.activateConfirm: Activate this version for subsequent local analyses? A single test does not establish model quality.
PromptLab.rollbackConfirm: Restore built-in instructions for subsequent analyses?
PromptLab.historyNote: Last 30 actual tests. Missing values remain unknown. Test message text is not stored.
PromptLab.compareNote: Operational comparison, not an accuracy ranking. Test texts are not stored; different inputs and conditions may affect results.

Evaluations.title: Evaluate with synthetic examples
Evaluations.intro: Error counts apply only to this authored dataset, not real-world effectiveness. HIGH_RISK is positive; ambiguous cases are excluded from binary metrics. Model failures are not counted as successful rules fallbacks.
Evaluations.consent: I consent to sending four synthetic examples to the configured model provider and incurring any provider charges.
Evaluations.limit: Rules: complete dataset. AI: first four examples, connectivity only. At most one run per five minutes. Recommendation safety is not measured.
Evaluations.datasetNote: challenge-v1 contains {count} authored examples covering benign, ambiguous and malicious scenarios. The dataset is versioned in the repository; browser editing is not yet available.

Models.title: Models in this workspace
Models.intro: Choose which model IDs the configured endpoint may use. Select one default. Changes affect subsequent analyses and prompt tests; saving does not call or validate the model.
Models.cannotRemoveDefault: Select another default before removing this model.
Models.invalid: Enter a unique model ID using letters, numbers, dots, underscores, slashes or hyphens (up to 120 characters).
Models.note: Model availability and token pricing are not verified here. Configure the endpoint and credentials under Model service.
Models.error: Could not save the model registry.
Models.conflict: Another administrator changed the configuration. Reload this page before saving.

Providers.title: Model service configuration
Providers.intro: Settings apply to subsequent analyses and tests. The key and allowed endpoint remain server-side. Disabling blocks new model requests; in-flight calls may finish. This form cannot disable the production guard.
Providers.endpointNote: Register trusted endpoints in server configuration before selecting them here. Credentials stay in server environment variables.
Providers.healthReady: The saved endpoint responded to /models in {duration} ms. This does not verify model capability or price.
Providers.healthHttp: The saved endpoint returned HTTP {status}. Check its URL and credential.
Providers.healthUnavailable: Could not reach the saved endpoint, or the check is rate limited.
Providers.healthNote: This explicit check sends no message text and does not request a model completion. It uses the saved configuration, not unsaved edits.
Providers.diagnosticNote: Prompt Lab makes a real request using this configuration and records status, duration and reported tokens. Consent is required. Unknown prices are not estimated. Automatic fallback to another paid model is not enabled; analysis falls back to rules on failure.
